info.title: La città delle bestie ammaliatrici
info.synopsis: Per millenni tra la razza umana e quella dei demoni appartenenti al Lato Oscuro c'è uno scontro segreto, di cui le persone normali non sono a conoscenza. Nel corso della storia dell'umanità ci sono stati molti contatti con il Lato Oscuro. Gli Illuminati del nostro mondo e dell'altro hanno sempre cercato di armonizzare fra loro, scambiandosi idee e conoscenze, imparando a vivere in pace. Ma c'erano altre persone che, per interesse, volevano tenere i due mondi separati e in guerra. A causa loro ci furono anni di genocidi e distruzioni. Alla fine gli Illuminati aumentarono il loro potere in entrambi i mondi, finché fu stipulato un patto di non aggressione. Questo accadeva molti secoli fa e l'ultimo trattato è stato violato parecchie volte ma, alla fine del ventesimo secolo sta per essere stipulato un nuovo trattato di pace. Però alcuni membri del Lato Oscuro non desiderano che venga rinnovato. Per firmare un nuovo trattato viene richiamato dall'Italia il dottor Giuseppe Maiato, il più importante ambasciatore della razza umana, la cui presenza è fondamentale per la firma del trattato. Come guardie del corpo di questo importante personaggio vengono scelti l'umano Renzaburo Taki e la bellissima Makie, appartenente alla razza del Lato Oscuro. Ma non tutto è come sembra e dietro al rinnovo del trattato c'è un piano secolare con lo scopo finale di far integrare le due razze.

info.title: Pretty Cure All Stars DX – Il film 2: Luce della speranza ☆ Proteggi il Rainbow Jewel!
info.synopsis: Tsubomi e Erika ricevono una lettera da parte di Chypre e Coffret in cui vengono invitate a visitare il Fairy Park, un parco di divertimenti che sorge una volta ogni mille anni, in cui appare la mistica gemma Rainbow Jewel. Arrivate sul posto, le ragazze incontrano Love, Miki, Inori e Setsuna, che chiedono loro di aiutarle a cercare le altre amiche all’interno del parco. Improvvisamente vengono attaccate da Uraganos, Kintresky, Mucardia e Northa, che rivelano che il Rainbow Jewel è preso di mira da Bottom, un’entità malvagia che vuole impossessarsi del suo potere per avvolgere il mondo nell’oscurità e nell’infelicità..

info.title: Ichigo Aika: Strawberry Elegy
info.synopsis: Dopo le seconde nozze del padre, Kōta si ritrova a convivere con una nuova sorellastra, Aika. All'apparenza è una gyaru educata e rispettosa con i genitori, ma lontano dai loro occhi rivela un carattere vivace, impertinente e provocatorio. La convivenza all'inizio è difficile e il ragazzo fatica a tollerare i suoi atteggiamenti, che gli rendono la vita complicata. Con il passare del tempo, però, dietro la maschera ribelle emergono lati più autentici e affettuosi, e il rapporto tra i due prende una direzione inaspettata.

episodes.title: A Pair of Really Crappy Siblings!
episodes.synopsis: Aika, the new younger sister of Kota Takamura from his father's remarriage, is a super sassy gal who bluntly calls her stepbrother “lame” upon first meet. Calling each other names, with each holding the worst impression of the other, they begin living under the same roof. But Aika would bring men into her room and get down to business whenever the parents were out. Kota is greatly troubled by her loud and clear moans, but then one day, something changes...

episodes.title: The Hell Are You?!
episodes.synopsis: That day, Aika was indulging in intimacy with her boyfriend Takahashi in her room as usual. However, a certain situation stirs trouble between them. To make matters worse for Aika, Kota, who had heard the commotion, shows up at the door. Aika tries to brush him off and send him away, but Kota makes a bold move that takes them both by surprise.

episodes.title: A Secret From Mom
episodes.synopsis: Despite Aika skipping school and bringing boys home—behavior that could be called delinquent—she hides it from her parents and acts like a model daughter... Living together, Kota witnesses her dual nature firsthand. One day, Kota accidentally runs into Aika in the bathroom right after she's had a shower. Wondering which is the real Aika, he plucks up the courage to ask her directly...

episodes.title: A Ready-Made Duo
episodes.synopsis: That night after the incident in the bathroom, Aika and Kota each lay in their own rooms, lost in thoughts of the other. Aika replays Kota's words and actions in her mind, sensing something different from the guys she'd dated before—guys who were only after her body. Late at night, Kota goes to the kitchen to prepare instant noodles for a late-night snack. Then, Aika comes over...

episodes.title: Aika's Close Call!
episodes.synopsis: Aika still lets Takahashi into her room, although today she seems unusually reluctant. The tactless Takahashi doesn't seem to care however, teasing that all guys get horny around the sexy Aika. Aika snaps and slaps him across the face. Takahashi then changes his tune, trying to force himself on her...

episodes.title: Just Hold Me Tight, Dammit
episodes.synopsis: Kota narrowly defeats Takahashi and succeeds in protecting Aika. But now, with Aika still in her disheveled state, she asks him to hold her tight, leaving him flustered. Out of a sense of responsibility as her older brother, Kota tells her to put her clothes back on properly. However, after she had tidied herself, Aika demands he embrace her once more. Kota found himself cornered, with nowhere to escape.

episodes.title: Breaking Down is a Bad Idea!
episodes.synopsis: From hugging to touching of the lips— Just when they were about to cross the line, Misaki comes home, leaving Aika and Kota unfinished. Just when that seemed to be the end of it, the next day, when their parents had gone out and they were alone together, Aika makes her move and asks if they can finish off from yesterday. Overwhelmed by Aika's bold approach, Kota almost goes with the flow again...

episodes.title: Why Don't You Take It Like A Man
episodes.synopsis: The Takamura family heads to Atami for a trip! While his parents enjoy some couple time alone, Kota explores the sights by himself, making the most of the trip. Later, as he rests back at the inn, Aika returns to the room in her yukata after bathing. Kota can't help but be captivated by Aika's different, more traditional Japanese-style vibe—a change from her usual self. But Aika is quick to sense his gaze...

episodes.title: My Fave Kind of Guy!
episodes.synopsis: The Takamura family's Atami trip continues! Aika and Kota arrive at the beach. While Aika, in her swimsuit, is strolling alone, she gets hit on by a guy. Though inwardly fed up, Aika decides to play it cool to avoid trouble. She tries to brush him off, casually dropping that her friend's here and makes her escape. But the unexpectedly clueless guy doesn't get the hint, and forcefully grabs Aika's hand, plunging her into an unexpected predicament.

episodes.title: Here Like Normal
episodes.synopsis: Now it's become perfectly normal for Aika to read manga in Kouta's room. She brings all the volumes out to read them all at once in the living room, but the moment she sees the dark hallway, she becomes strange and dejected, returning to Kouta's room. Aika confesses to Kouta that she's scared of being alone. Kouta assumes she just hates being on her own, but it seems there was more to it than that...

episodes.title: Kinda Bad-Boy, Don'tcha Think?
episodes.synopsis: Aika realizes she feels both excited and satisfied from her physical closeness with Kouta. Then at that moment, the image of a certain guy who once boasted that he'll teach her what real love is, flashes through her mind... Kouta, having finished his part-time job, was about to head home when he coincidentally runs into Aika, who was visiting as a customer. They end up going home together, but Aika leads him to a certain place.

episodes.title: From Teary To Twinkly
episodes.synopsis: Aika boldly barges in on Kouta's bath time, holding a trendy bath bomb. Meanwhile, Kouta, concerned by Aika's tears he saw in the ruins, blurts out something that spoils the mood. However, Aika's reaction was different from what Kouta had expected. Sensing something, Kouta asks Aika to tell him about herself. Then, Aika begins to recount a certain event from her past.

info.title: Baki-dou: The Invincible Samurai
info.synopsis: Baki è annoiato. Dopo la conclusione della battaglia epica tra padre e figlio, lui continua a fare combattimenti underground e ad allenarsi senza fermarsi, ma deve sempre reprimere il suo sbadiglio causato dalla noia. Nessuno stimolo o pericolo può portare eccitazione in lui in questo momento. Ora, con l'inclusione del Primo Ministro Giapponese nel circuito, un grande progetto di clonazione di massa sta provando a clonare Miyamoto Musashi, uno dei padri delle arti marziali in Giappone. Un'altra battaglia di proporzioni epiche attende Baki!

episodes.synopsis: As the other martial artists battle restlessness, Kaoru Hanayama asks Tokugawa for a favor. Deep underground, the cloning project enters its final phase.

episodes.title: The Countenance of Musashi
episodes.synopsis: As Professor John accepts Sabuko's arcane methods against scientific reasoning, Hanayama gears up for an all-out fistfight with Yujiro on Tokyo's streets.

episodes.title: Boy
episodes.synopsis: After facing Japan's greatest modern swordsman, the peerless Musashi Miyamoto demands the most skilled fighters in the country. Baki steps forward.

episodes.title: Otherworldly Strength
episodes.synopsis: Baki unleashes his fastest strike — but the samurai is faster. Later, as Musashi roams the city, his actions catch the attention of other martial artists.

episodes.title: Real Sword
episodes.synopsis: The first to move is Doppo Orochi. After a brief tussle, he asks Musashi to use a real blade. How will God's Hand fare against the sword saint's steel?

episodes.title: Feather
episodes.synopsis: Sea King Retsu arrives to face Musashi and trains intensively under the watchful eye of Sea Emperor Kaku to master the secret technique: Xiaoli.

episodes.title: You Are Defeated!
episodes.synopsis: The battle between kenpo master Retsu and sword master Musashi Miyamoto begins! While Retsu unleashes long-range weapon attacks, Musashi closes in!?

episodes.title: Sea King Retsu
episodes.synopsis: Barely standing after Musashi's barrage of brutal attacks, Retsu forces his broken body forward and adopts a familiar stance. Can he turn the tide?

episodes.title: Sekigahara
episodes.synopsis: The deathmatch between Retsu and Musashi comes to a devastatingly brutal conclusion. Baki visits Izo Motobe for guidance and flies into a rage.

episodes.title: Buddy
episodes.synopsis: After defeating Japan's kendo champ, Musashi faces jujutsu master Goki Shibukawa, who greets the samurai with a firm handshake — and a punch to the face.

episodes.title: Tough Body
episodes.synopsis: The strongest being on Earth clashes with the strongest samurai in history at the Tokugawa estate! Yujiro demands Musashi face him with two swords.

episodes.title: Practical Fighter
episodes.synopsis: Jack Hammer arrives at the Tokugawa estate hoping to fight Musashi, but first must defeat Motobe, who's determined to be the next to take on the samurai.

episodes.synopsis: En vuole vendere dei pessimi funghi e Cayman sembra essersi ricordato qualcosa di importante.

episodes.synopsis: So the Cross-Eyes gang figured they’d make the landlord’s murder look like a suicide, huh? As for Asu, who dared to keep things from me, I made sure he paid for it.

episodes.synopsis: Looks like Ebisu got her memory back, thanks to eating some weird mushrooms, and now she’s all eager to head back to her parents’ place.

episodes.title: Addio, Caiman / Bolle di memoria
episodes.synopsis: En’s found the lizard guy and Nikaido, and they’re going at it hard. Meanwhile, the Cross-Eyes guys are sitting around swapping stories about their boss.

episodes.title: Il mio piano segreto / Spedizione occhi crociati / Riunione deformata
episodes.synopsis: Fujita's losing his mind trying to get Kikurage to bring Ebisu back to life. The Cross-Eyes guys are scrambling for cash, and things around En are starting to get kind of dicey.

episodes.title: Caos e shock / La scatola nera / Stanza 501
episodes.synopsis: I never imagined En would go down that easily. The sorcerers are thrown into total chaos. And now I get why Nikaido doesn't use magic.

episodes.title: L'area del pogo / Notizie sugli Occhi crociati
episodes.synopsis: The Cross-Eyes boss has finally shown up. The En Family's been wiped out, and it looks like the Cross-Eyes have taken over that huge mansion.

episodes.title: Manzo fortunato / Magia avanzata
episodes.synopsis: Looks like they've found missing Kikurage. And that bastard Asu, well, Kawajiri now, is sneaking around, up to something weird again. That Haru chick’s getting a little too carried away.

episodes.title: Un incontro romantico e violento / Domande e risposte
episodes.synopsis: Looks like Kawajiri and Nikaido have slipped into En's mansion, which the Cross-Eyes have taken over. There, Nikaido runs right into Aikawa. The mystery surrounding the Cross-Eyes boss just keeps getting deeper.

info.title: Shurato - L'epica degli dei celesti: le tenebre della creazione
info.synopsis: Conclusa la battaglia per la Sfera Celeste, Shurato e Gai vengono cancellati dalla storia. Quando una nuova minaccia emerge sulla Terra, gli Otto Guardiani sono chiamati a indagare. In un mondo che non lo ricorda più, Shurato cerca di ritrovare i suoi amici, mentre un misterioso nemico trama nell'ombra per realizzare un oscuro piano che potrebbe mettere in pericolo entrambi i mondi.

info.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
info.synopsis: Sasaki è un impiegato di 45 anni intrappolato nella monotonia del lavoro e della vita quotidiana. L'unico momento di sollievo nella sua routine è la breve visita serale a un supermercato, dove la gentilezza e il sorriso della giovane cassiera Yamada riescono, anche solo per un attimo, a fargli dimenticare lo stress. Una sera, però, Yamada ha già finito il turno e l'uomo, deluso, si rifugia dietro il negozio per fumare. Lì incontra Tayama: una donna misteriosa, schietta e diretta, molto diversa dalla dolce Yamada... eppure, qualcosa in lei gli sembra stranamente familiare. Tra una sigaretta e l’altra, Sasaki scopre in Tayama una nuova compagna di silenzi e parole non dette. E così, tra i corridoi illuminati del supermercato e l’ombra tranquilla dell’area fumatori, la sua vita inizia lentamente a cambiare...

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: The series of incidents involving the former Yozakura heads turn out to part of Momo's plot to resurrect his beloved wife, Rei. As he whispers about his twisted love for his family, Momo vanishes from Mutsumi and the others' sight. Meanwhile, Kyoichiro, who was saved by Taiyo's Profuse Blooming of 10,000 Flowers, returns home to his siblings. The touching reunion is short-lived, as in order to make him reflect after trying to sacrifice himself to protect the family, a "Day of Family Service" begins! What lies in store for Kyoichiro is his siblings' merciless requests... Just then, a message arrives for Mutsumi.

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: Under Mutsumi's orders, Kyoichiro and Taiyo pursue the fleeing Momo. Taiyo manages to land a punch on Momo once, but the gap in abilities between himself and Momo, who can hold his own against Kyoichiro, is all too clear, and he's left on the defensive. On top of that, numerous Dark Cherries - creatures birthed by Tsubomi, which feed on humans as nutrients - appear, blocking the way. Taiyo launches another attack, but he falls just short, letting Momo get away. Kyoichiro destroys the Dark Cherries, and is about to take Taiyo back with him to Mutsumi, when he's suddenly summoned by the chairman of the Spy Association, Kai Izumo...
